title: Final Displacement
description: Essential Criteria: The final displacement S must be correctly calculated as 0.25 ft.

title: Acceleration Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for acceleration, including the effects of gravity and friction.

title: Time of Upward Motion
description: Important Criteria: The time of upward motion t1 should be accurately calculated as 0.25 s.

title: Displacement During Upward Motion
description: Important Criteria: The displacement during the upward motion must be computed correctly as 5/8 ft.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the acceleration or displacement calculations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Friction Coefficient Usage
description: Important Criteria: The coefficient of friction must be applied correctly in the equations of motion.

title: Final Velocity Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the final velocity of the brick at t = 0.5 s as a check on their calculations.
